image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a computer keyboard featuring dark gray keys with white lettering on a silver chassis. The bottom row contains an elongated space bar centered between modifier keys. The keycaps appear to have a matte finish, and the layout resembles a standard QWERTY configuration, though the characters are slightly indistinct.

There is a faint, unreadable string of text or logo artifact on the silver bezel below the space bar. It looks like gibberish rather than a brand name, suggesting minor generation noise.

The rightmost keys seem to compress or fade into the background slightly unnaturally, though this could be depth-of-field blur. The alignment of the grid is mostly consistent but feels slightly 'soft' or warped near the edges.
